items.exampleEn: The company has a clear vision for the future.
items.exampleZh: 這家公司對未來有清楚的願景。

items.exampleEn: Our cat refuses to eat this kind of food.
items.exampleZh: 我們的貓不肯吃這種食物。

items.exampleEn: This young player has great potential.
items.exampleZh: 這位年輕球員很有潛力。

items.exampleEn: The children behaved well in the presence of their grandparents.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們在祖父母面前很有禮貌。

items.exampleEn: Honesty is one of my most important principles.
items.exampleZh: 誠實是我最重要的原則之一。

items.exampleEn: The movie was loved by critics but not by audiences.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影受到影評人喜愛，但觀眾不買單。

items.exampleEn: Thank you for your helpful comments on my report.
items.exampleZh: 謝謝你對我的報告提出有用的意見。

items.exampleEn: It is a common belief that money brings happiness.
items.exampleZh: 很多人普遍相信金錢能帶來快樂。

items.sentenceEn: Please leave your comments in the box by the door.
items.sentenceZh: 請把你的意見放進門邊的箱子裡。

items.audioEn: The manager refused our plan because it would cost too much.
items.audioZh: 經理拒絕了我們的計畫，因為花費太高。
items.questionZh: 經理為什麼拒絕這個計畫？

items.sentenceEn: Every child has the potential to learn a second language.
items.sentenceZh: 每個孩子都有學會第二語言的潛力。

items.sentenceEn: Her strong beliefs help her stay calm in hard times.
items.sentenceZh: 堅定的信念幫助她在困難時期保持冷靜。

items.stemEn: Your ____ is required at the meeting tomorrow, so please don't be late.
items.stemZh: 明天的會議需要你出席，所以請不要遲到。

items.stemEn: The famous ____ wrote a bad review of the new restaurant.
items.stemZh: 那位有名的評論家給這家新餐廳寫了負評。

items.passageEn: Mr. Su started a small bakery ten years ago with a clear vision: to make healthy bread at a fair price. His main principle is never to use cheap materials. Many people told him he would fail, but he refused to listen. At first, food critics made only a few comments about his shop. Now his bakery has a strong presence in the city, with five stores and numerous regular customers. His belief in good bread has proved right, and he thinks his business still has great potential.
items.passageZh: 蘇先生十年前開了一家小麵包店，他有一個清楚的願景：用合理的價格做健康的麵包。他最主要的原則是絕不用便宜的材料。很多人說他會失敗，但他拒絕聽信。一開始，美食評論家對他的店只有寥寥幾句評論。現在他的麵包店在城裡很有存在感，有五家分店和許多常客。他對好麵包的信念證明是對的，而且他認為自己的生意還有很大的潛力。

questions.questionZh: 蘇先生最主要的原則是什麼？
他的麵包店現在怎麼樣？

referenceEn: She refused to take the job.
rubricZh: refuse 可直接接名詞（例如 refuse the offer），或接 to＋原形動詞（例如 refuse to take the job）
過去的事用過去式（例如 refused）
寫 turned down 意思也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 principle 造一個句子，說說你做人或做事的一個原則。
referenceEn: One of my principles is to always be on time.
I have a simple principle: never spend more than I earn.
rubricZh: principle 表示「原則」，可用 One of my principles is…、My principle is… 等
說的是自己的原則（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
